subject: config: enable CONFIG_RTW88_8821AU for Realtek 8821AU/8811AU USB adapters (#81)
author: Julian Seitz

impact.effect_if_absent: Realtek 8821AU/8811AU USB WiFi adapters such as TP-Link Archer T2U Nano bind no driver and produce no wlan interface. The rtw88_8821au kernel driver contains the USB device IDs but was not built because CONFIG_RTW88_8821AU was disabled.

notes:
HYPOTHESIS CONFIRMED: board/mister/de10nano/linux.config has had CONFIG_RTW88_8821AU=m since the v10 Wi-Fi expansion (docs/wifi-parity.md §6.4, ADR 0016). This commit enables the same setting in the fork's defconfig. Disposition: dropped-deliberate, identical to the CONFIG_MACVLAN/CONFIG_TUN precedent cited in PLAN.md §2.2.

EVIDENCE: (1) Our linux.config line 623: CONFIG_RTW88_8821AU=m. After olddefconfig on v6.18.49 (the reachable pin; 6.18.50 unverified per env.md), resolved config shows: CONFIG_RTW88_8821AU=m, CONFIG_RTW88_8821A=m (auto-selected), CONFIG_RTW88_88XXA=m (auto-selected via RTW88_8821A), CONFIG_RTW88_USB=m (auto-selected). Kconfig chain in drivers/net/wireless/realtek/rtw88/Kconfig confirms: RTW88_8821AU selects RTW88_CORE, RTW88_USB, and RTW88_8821A; RTW88_8821A selects RTW88_88XXA. (2) Firmware rtw8821a_fw.bin is shipped via BR2_PACKAGE_LINUX_FIRMWARE_RTL_RTW88 (already present in image-common.fragment and present in stock firmware inventory). (3) Device motivation: TP-Link Archer T2U Nano (2357:011e) is listed in v6.18.49 drivers/net/wireless/realtek/rtw88/rtw8821au.c line 48-49 with comment /* TP Link */. (4) Stock baseline evidence: stock-20260907-linux.config line 1682 has CONFIG_RTW88_8821AU disabled (# CONFIG_RTW88_8821AU is not set); stock-20260907-modules.txt contains NO rtw88_8821au.ko. (5) Userspace coupling: none expected; grep of Main_MiSTer for '8821AU', '8821au', 'rtw8821', '2357' yields no matches. No device-specific event codes, ioctls, sysfs paths, or /dev nodes in Main_MiSTer.

IMPLICATION FOR STOCK USERS: Stock MiSTer 20260907 users with Archer T2U Nano adapters have no driver; our image has provided the driver since July 2026. This is a capability we already owned before the fork commit and the defconfig alignment.
